# Rafa Gomes

> Head of Engineering at Oak Network and an AI engineering leader with 18+ years of experience building agentic AI systems, full-stack platforms, and blockchain products.

## Who

- Name: Rafa Gomes
- Role: Head of Engineering, Oak Network (global)
- Focus: AI engineering — agentic systems, multi-agent orchestration, LLM-powered tooling, and AI-assisted development
- Experience: 18+ years across engineering and technical leadership
- Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil (GMT-3)
- Languages spoken: Portuguese (native), English (professional)
- Core tech: Go, Rust, TypeScript, Node.js/Nest.js, React/Next.js, AWS, EVM/Solana
- Differentiator: a security background (CEH, ethical hacking, threat modeling) applied to building resilient AI systems

## Summary

Rafa Gomes is an engineering leader focused on AI engineering. As Head of Engineering at Oak
Network he owns the global engineering roadmap and drives agentic-AI development — intelligent
agent systems, autonomous workflows, multi-agent orchestration, and LLM-powered tooling —
alongside full-stack and blockchain execution on AWS infrastructure. Over 18+ years he has
shipped protocols and SDKs (Gateway), AI algorithms at an early-stage health-tech company
(Justpoint/Intrellit), and full-stack platforms for clients including American Express and
Petrobras. He also builds in the open: his ai-workflow toolkit brings structured skills, agents,
and full-SDLC conventions to AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.
He separately publishes security research under the identity "0xrafasec" (CVE deep-dives,
malware analysis, and blockchain security).

## Experience (recent)

- Head of Engineering, Oak Network (2026–present; Head of Engineering LATAM 2025–2026)
- Lead Full-Stack Engineer, Gateway (2022–2025) — protocol, SDK, core products in Node.js/Go/Next.js
- Lead Full-Stack Engineer, Justpoint/Intrellit (2020–2021) — AI health-tech
- Software Engineering Manager, Accenture Song (2018–2020)
- Lead/Senior Full-Stack Engineer, Huge (2011–2017) — American Express, enterprise clients

## Selected projects

- ai-workflow — AI-assisted development workflow toolkit for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex: https://github.com/rafagomes/ai-workflow
- ecies-bls12381 — Go package for ECIES encryption over the BLS12-381 curve: https://github.com/rafagomes/ecies-bls12381
- rfirewall — a user-centric firewall for Linux, written in Rust: https://github.com/rafagomes/rfirewall
